text: この　わざを　おしえて　もらえるのは　いちど　だけですが　いいですか？

structure.jp: この　わざを　おしえて　もらえるのは
structure.en: being able to be taught this move

structure.jp: いちど　だけですが

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: おしえて　もらえる
patterns.explanation: もらう after the て-form says someone does the thing for you; the える ending here adds 'can'. おしえて　もらえる = 'can have it taught to you'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing you can talk about. おしえて　もらえるのは = 'the times you can be taught it'.

patterns.name: 〜が (lead-in)
patterns.span: いちど　だけですが
patterns.explanation: が at the end of the first half is a soft 'but' that sets up the question that follows. いちど　だけですが　いいですか = 'it's only once, is that okay?'
